revisions.poseBrief: Jill kneels on one knee on the boardwalk, lifting a coiled red rescue rope beside a beach-safety basket and looking toward the sea.
revisions.themeBrief: Adult Jill on a public beach in a covering blue-gray athletic summer outfit, natural active pose; family-safe, non-sexualized, no weapon or romance.

visualReview.notes: Blue beret, brown bob, navy athletic jacket, cargo shorts over cropped navy leggings, sandals, tote and rolled mat retained. New kneeling rescue task and white boathouse beach composition are distinct from the old standing shoreline picture.

revisions.poseBrief: Jill bends her knees in a broad side-on stance and slides a wooden supply crate onto a station storage shelf, a baggage trolley beside her.
revisions.themeBrief: Adult Jill in a professional blue safe-room steward uniform methodically organizes supplies; family-safe, practical, non-sexualized and not submissive.

visualReview.notes: Professional navy long-sleeved steward dress, blue beret, long gray apron, opaque stockings and practical black shoes retained. No tactical shoulder pads or weapon. Railway trusses, platform benches, trolley and shelves differ from the old stone storeroom.

revisions.poseBrief: Jill braces one boot on a low greenhouse step, supports a tall stack of three herb pots beside one shoulder and holds a tiny pouch far away at shoulder height with the opposite hand.
revisions.themeBrief: Jill tries to fit far too many healing herbs into a small tactical pouch with professional calm; a visual gag without text.

visualReview.notes: RE1 beret, bob, blue-gray shirt, shoulder pads, belt, cargo trousers, thigh holster, gloves and boots retained. The oversized herb-pot versus tiny-pouch gag is explicit. Broad asymmetrical arm pose replaces the old hands-together waist gesture; red-brick greenhouse replaces wood storage shelves.

revisions.poseBrief: Bareheaded Jill turns back over her shoulder on a snowy terrace, one hand resting on the railing and the other holding the complete pistol pointed down.
revisions.themeBrief: What If branch: Jill becomes a rival biotech operative in a dark-red tactical uniform without logos, retaining her skill and silhouette; no victims.

visualReview.notes: Slot-specific dark-red and charcoal uniform, dark shoulder armor, cargo panels, belt, thigh holster, gloves and boots retained, with no blue beret added. Snowfields, white radomes and satellite dishes replace the old red laboratory tanks; no victims or mutations.

revisions.poseBrief: The adult male Jill interpretation leans against a timber boathouse support with arms crossed and one bent leg resting a boot against the post; the handgun remains holstered.
revisions.themeBrief: Separate What If branch: an adult male interpretation of Jill with the same blue-gray S.T.A.R.S. uniform, beret, equipment and competence; no caricature.

visualReview.notes: Male face, square jaw, light stubble, short brown hair, blue beret and precise blue-gray tactical equipment retained. The relaxed crossed-arm silhouette is distinct from the original two-hand pistol stance. Stone boathouse, timber rafters and canal replace mansion hallway.

revisions.poseBrief: Jill sits leaning forward on an infirmary cot, one hand at her forehead and the other lowered beside the cot edge, both boots visible and pistol holstered.
revisions.themeBrief: What If branch: early viral infection shown by pallor and subtle veins, with Jill and her uniform still readable; no gore, wound or humiliating pose.

visualReview.notes: RE1 uniform and beret retained. Pallor and fine blue-purple veins show early non-graphic infection without wounds or gore. Riveted railway compartment, round window and medicine cabinet replace the mansion hallway; seated pose is distinct from the old standing stance.

revisions.poseBrief: Experienced maritime Jill takes a long step on engine-room steel stairs, one hand gripping the rail and the other holding a complete pistol safely downward.
revisions.themeBrief: Attested timeline variant: adult Jill as an experienced BSAA agent, wearing Revelations-inspired maritime tactical gear aboard an original ship, no real likeness.

visualReview.notes: Brown bob and original adult stylized face retained. Navy zipped jacket, black shoulder harness and clipped radio, gray cargo trousers, holster, gloves and boots match the maritime variant; no RE1 beret or shoulder pads. Steel stairs, blue diesel machinery and large ventilation ducts replace the old rainy ship corridor.
